scope: Operational observations from the retained qualification campaign; process durations overlap and must not be added to infer host runtime.
observation_provenance: Host and process values were copied from controller and /usr/bin/time output before the host was terminated. Those operational logs are not part of this public reference, so these values are contextual observations rather than replay-verified evidence.

model_collection.timing_note: The host elapsed value uses the conservative billing clock from host boot. Process durations are /usr/bin/time observations and overlap because captures ran concurrently. Transfer and decommission latency after capture completion are excluded.

independent_recipient.measurement_status: Dedicated recipient elapsed-time and memory instrumentation was not retained. File modification times are not used as substitutes.

judge_collection.measurement_status: Provider usage was retained, but a single campaign wall-clock duration and provider invoice were not. The estimate uses the then-reviewed uncached standard token rates and is not a bill.
